name: get-guidelines-lambda
description: Retrieves donation and food-safety guideline details for a specific guideline type, including Acceptance rules, safe donation Windows (how long after preparation/best-before an item can still be donated), and Handling instructions

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for retrieving a donation/food-safety guideline

guideline_type.description: The type of guideline to retrieve. Must be one of: Acceptance, Window, or Handling

outputSchema.description: Response containing the requested guideline details

guideline_details.description: The detailed text content of the requested donation/food-safety guideline
